Jared: Kicking off VoltPack marketplace onboarding. Need clear owners for: AMI/GCE/VHD uploads, offer metadata, legal copy, pricing model, and a staging publish date.
Meera: I'll own the manifest + pricing shape. Proposal: 14-day trial + per-seat metered with a base seat.
Koji: Infra needs exact artifacts: AWS AMI id, GCP image name, Azure VHD path, and a tiny terraform outputs file. Example outputs I expect: `publisher_account_id`, `listing_bucket`, `kms_key_arn`.
Rina: Legal will provide EULA + short DPA clause and a telemetry blurb. Telemetry policy: aggregated only, 30-day retention, opt-out available.
PartnerOps: Staging resources created. Uploaded artifacts to vault: AMI `ami-0d4e5f6a`, GCP image `voltpack-stg-2026-06-10`, Azure VHD `voltpack-stg.vhd`. Publisher creds + asset links in 1Password.
Jared: Great. Meera please include `recommended_instance` and `min_vcpu` but avoid hard-pinning instance families in the manifest. Also add a `marketing_contact` email and docs URL.
Meera: Manifest skeleton posted to 1Password under `marketplace/manifests/voltpack.json`. Snippet: `\{"offerId\":\"<tbd>\",\"sku\":\"voltpack-trial\",\"pricing\":{\"trial_days\":14,\"model\":\"per_seat\"},\"recommended_instance\":\"g5.xlarge\"}`
Koji: I'll drop the TF outputs file to the vault and an ARM snippet for Azure. Will include `kms_key_arn` and `delegated_admin` role ARN.
Rina: Uploading legal drafts to Drive. Telemetry blurb ready: "Aggregated non-PII usage retained 30 days; customers may opt out via account settings." Adding export-control statement too.
PartnerOps: I also opened publisher support tickets with AWS/GCP to pre-map entitlements and requested a publisher onboarding window next week.
DeployBot: Staging preflight job scheduled: preflight-2123456789 on 2026-06-15 09:00 UTC.
Jared: Action list: 1) Koji - TF outputs + ARM/GCP pointers by EOD. 2) Rina - finalize EULA/DPA and paste legal notes in manifest by Wed. 3) PartnerOps - confirm final offerId + upload marketing assets (SVG, 1200x600 PNG, screenshots, demo link). 4) Meera - update manifest with offerId once provided.
Koji: Acknowledged. Will ping when TF outputs landed.
Rina: Will post links here after upload.
PartnerOps: Offer metadata draft: offerId `redwood-volt-2026`, publisher display `Redwood Inference`, sku `voltpack-trial-v1`. Assets uploaded and checksummed.
Meera: Incorporated offerId and assets into manifest. Waiting on legal text for the privacy/telemetry section before running staging upload.
Jared: Thanks team. Dry-run publish targeted for 2026-06-16 10:00 PT. Ping @Jared if anything blocks. :rocket:
